title: REVIEW BY SOMEONE WHO WAS **NOT** GIVEN THE PRODUCT TO MAKE A REVIEW.  STUPID ENOUGH TO BUY IT.
text:
REVIEW BY SOMEONE WHO WAS **NOT** GIVEN THE PRODUCT TO MAKE A REVIEW. STUPID ENOUGH TO BUY IT.. I wanted to like them. No, I wanted to love them. Badly. But really these are poorly made and designed. The idea is a nice one...it could have been a lovely hook.

The very top part, the hook itself, is very large so it causes it to wobble and be unstable in any standard American house door. Plus, we painted some of the doors in our home in a dark color and the constant rubbing and scratching of these hooks has already damaged our paint job.

The hooks part with the white balls, the part where one actually would hang something, are built too close to the top of the entire thing (like its growth was stunted or mistakenly cut short)...we are tall in our household, but if you are even a tiny bit on the short side you might have a hard time getting things on and off these hooks.

Lastly, because the whole thing is unstable and wobbles and moves around constantly, aside from the damage to the doors, you can expect to use only the middle hook as using the other ones will take the thing completely off balance.
